problem_type: Hand-copied strict boundary key table silently diverges from the shared type it validates
symptom: Core Flow Smoke spend-confirm times out with 'Timed out waiting for generation draft request' (CI runs 45885580423 / 45885618959, local tests/ux/core-smoke-spend-confirm.walk.mjs on the PR build); the renderer logs agent_lane_execute_failed with 'Unrecognized key(s) in object: note' and the Agent sends no text request at all.
direct_cause: PR #1703 added the optional keys presets and note to ModelParameterControl (electron/shared/videoCapabilities/types.ts) and used them in the Seedream 5.5 layer-split mode. Both projections copy mode.params as-is into AgentModelEntry, and agentModelEntrySchema validates params with .strict() against a key list written by hand, so parseLaneComposerContext rejects the whole turn input.
class_root: The boundary key table was a hand-written copy of ModelParameterControl. z.ZodType<AgentModelEntry> only checks that the schema output fits the type, so a new optional key on the type compiles and is rejected at runtime, failing every Agent turn whose catalog contains a model that uses the key. 2026-11-14 (optionConstraints when.slotEmpty) was the previous instance of the same class.
migration: No persisted data changes. The hand-written params object literal is replaced in the same commit by agentParamShape, bound to keyof ModelParameterControl with satisfies; no second copy remains. Agent list_models now also shows presets and note for the one model that declares them (Seedream 5.5 layer split; plain explanatory sentences, not i18n keys).
affected_population: Every creator whose model catalog contains APIMart Seedream 5.5 (built-in seed): every canvas Agent turn is rejected before the first request
Any future archetype or ComfyUI-imported control that carries a key or mediaKind the hand-written table did not list
entry_points: electron/agentLane/laneDesktopInput.ts parseLaneComposerContext: the per-turn composer context (availableModels) sent by the canvas Agent panel
electron/shared/agentCapabilities/verbs/readVerbs.ts list_models outputSchema: the model-detail modes reuse the entry schema
internal_only_reason: The invariant is between two of our own files (a TypeScript type and the zod table that validates it at our IPC boundary); no third-party behavior decides it. zod's strict() and satisfies behave as documented and are not the cause.
invariants: The params key table at the Agent model-entry boundary has exactly the keys of ModelParameterControl; adding or removing a key on either side fails typecheck.
Every built-in archetype's every mode, projected by both real producers, passes both real boundaries.
Unknown keys are still rejected (the boundary stays strict).

door_reduction.why_not: agentParamShape is the one key table (before the fix the same place held the hand-written literal); laneDesktopInput validates the turn input coming from the renderer and readVerbs reuses the same shape as the list_models output contract. They are one table behind two necessary, different boundaries, so there is nothing to merge.

generality_proof: The key table is now typed against keyof ModelParameterControl, so the whole class (a new, renamed or removed control key) cannot compile without someone deciding the boundary shape; the class test walks every built-in archetype through both real producers and both real boundaries, so a value-level mismatch (like mediaKind audio) or a new archetype also fails CI by name.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own the one params key table for the Agent model-entry boundary, bound at compile time to ModelParameterControl and kept strict.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Projects mode.params as-is; agentModelEntryBoundary.class.test.ts feeds every seeded catalog row plus every built-in archetype through it and parses through agentModelEntrySchema and parseLaneComposerContext.
Projects mode.params as-is; the class test parses every entry of the seeded catalog and its list_models row and detail.
Validates what an Agent submits for relay onboarding; it is an input contract of its own, not a copy of ModelParameterControl, and archetype controls never flow into it.

recurrence.reason: Any new optional key or value on ModelParameterControl (archetype work lands weekly) reaches the strict table through the raw projections; it already happened with slotEmpty on 2026-11-14 and with presets / note here, and mediaKind audio (ComfyUI LoadAudio) was a latent third.
same_class_scan: grep wireEncoding and placeholder inside zod definitions across electron, src and scripts: availableModelsSchema.ts is the only zod copy of the control key list
tmp probe: every built-in archetype (132) projected through agentModelEntrySchema before the fix: only seedream-5-5 mode layers rejected (presets, note)
type vs table diff: mediaKind allows audio in the type (ComfyUI LoadAudio, commit ac9c78b46) but the table only allowed image / video; fixed in the same table
node scripts/eng-metrics.mjs --candidates docs/fixes/2026-09-09-agent-lane-models-block.root-cause.json: no prior contract owns this key table

prevention.invariant: agentParamShape satisfies Record<keyof ModelParameterControl, ZodTypeAny> and is used with strict().
prevention.failure_mode: A key added to or removed from ModelParameterControl without the table fails typecheck (TS1360); dropping strict() fails the class test.
prevention.strategy: Replace the hand-copied object literal with a table the compiler checks against the type, and add a class test over every built-in archetype and both producers / boundaries.

legacy_paths.rationale: The inline hand-written params object literal is deleted in the same commit; agentParamShape is the only table.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: zod and TypeScript satisfies work as documented; the gap was our duplicated key list.

residual_risks: Value-level ranges are still copied by hand (the enum for type, the literal for wireEncoding); only keys are compile-checked. The class test catches a mismatch only when a built-in archetype or seeded model actually uses the value.

list_models detail variants carry modelKey while readVerbs' detail variants table does not list it (pre-existing, outside this class: output schemas there serve provenance only, no runtime parse found); left for the Agent-channel owner.
Custom / relay-declared models with unusual control shapes are not in the seeded catalog, so the class test does not see them.
